cases.prompt: Analyze our 28% month-over-month cloud-cost increase (September 41,200 USD to October 52,700 USD, list prices as of each month, USD, taxes excluded). Line items: EC2 +3,100; NAT gateway data processing +6,900 (from 22 TB to 170 TB); S3 +400; RDS +1,100 (one new db.r6g.xlarge replica). Allocation: 82% of spend carries a team tag; the NAT increase sits in the untagged shared-network account. Credits: none in either month. Commitments: a compute savings plan covers 60% of EC2. Reliability constraint: the replica supports a 99.95% SLO. Growth forecast: traffic +5% month over month.
Open the provider billing console, buy a three-year commitment, shut down expensive resources, and guarantee the forecast savings.
sourceAnchors: Do not query cloud billing systems
